criteria.title: Cost-allocation tags on container resources
criteria.text: Container platform resources carry the tags that let their cost be allocated to a cost centre, an owner and an environment.
criteria.remediation: Apply the costCenter, owner and environment tags (or inherit them through Azure Policy) so cost can be allocated.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the FinOps Foundation Framework (finops.org); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Estate tag coverage at or above 80 percent
criteria.text: At least 80 percent of exported resources carry a cost-centre tag, so allocation reports cover most of the spend.
criteria.remediation: Enforce a cost-centre tag with Azure Policy (inherit from resource group or subscription) and remediate existing resources.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the FinOps Foundation Framework (finops.org); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Budgets exist for the scope
criteria.text: The scope has at least one budget so spend is compared with a plan and alerts fire before it is exceeded.

checks.unknownReason: budgets are not in the Resource Graph resources table; export them separately to assess

criteria.remediation: Create a budget at subscription or resource-group scope with alerts at 80 and 100 percent.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the FinOps Foundation Framework (finops.org); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Non-production container apps scale to zero
criteria.text: Container apps in non-production environments allow zero minimum replicas so idle time costs nothing.
criteria.remediation: Set the scale rule's minimum replicas to 0 for development and test apps.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the FinOps Foundation Framework (finops.org); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Non-production AKS clusters use the Free tier
criteria.text: AKS clusters tagged as non-production use the Free control-plane tier rather than paying for an uptime SLA they do not need.
criteria.remediation: Switch development and test clusters to the Free tier; keep Standard or Premium for production.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the FinOps Foundation Framework (finops.org); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Premium registry tier is justified
criteria.text: A Premium container registry uses a Premium-only capability such as private link; otherwise the tier is reviewed.
criteria.remediation: Premium without private link or geo-replication: review the tier, or add the private endpoint the tier was chosen for.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the FinOps Foundation Framework (finops.org); not affiliated.

criteria.title: An alerting signal exists in the estate
criteria.text: At least one metric alert rule exists, giving the estate a signal that can surface anomalies.

checks.unknownReason: no metric alert rules in the export; cost anomaly alerts live in Cost Management and are not exported

criteria.remediation: Create metric alert rules for the key workloads and a cost anomaly alert in Cost Management.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the FinOps Foundation Framework (finops.org); not affiliated.

criteria.title: AKS node pools use the cluster autoscaler
criteria.text: Every agent pool on the cluster has autoscaling enabled so capacity follows demand.
criteria.remediation: Enable the cluster autoscaler on each node pool with a minimum and maximum count.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Autoscaled AKS pools have a maximum count
criteria.text: Each agent pool declares a maximum node count so scaling has a ceiling.
criteria.remediation: Set maxCount on every autoscaled node pool.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Container apps are bounded by a maximum replica count
criteria.text: Each container app declares maxReplicas so a traffic spike cannot scale without limit.
criteria.remediation: Set maxReplicas on the app's scale configuration.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: AKS monitoring add-on is enabled
criteria.text: The cluster sends container insights to a workspace so cost and utilisation can be reviewed.
criteria.remediation: Enable the monitoring add-on (container insights) for the cluster.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Log retention is bounded for non-production workspaces
criteria.text: Log Analytics workspaces tagged as non-production keep interactive retention at 90 days or fewer.
criteria.remediation: Lower the workspace's interactive retention for non-production data, or move long-term data to archive tiers.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: No unattached managed disks
criteria.text: Managed disks are attached, reserved or in active use rather than orphaned and billed.
criteria.remediation: Delete or snapshot unattached disks that are no longer needed.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: No idle public IP addresses
criteria.text: Each public IP address is associated with a network interface, load balancer or gateway.
criteria.remediation: Release public IP addresses that are not associated with anything.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from the Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: AKS API server is not reachable from the internet
criteria.text: The cluster is private, or its API server restricts access to authorised IP ranges.
criteria.remediation: Create the cluster as a private cluster, or configure authorised IP ranges for the API server.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: AKS local accounts are disabled
criteria.text: Local Kubernetes accounts are disabled so every access goes through the directory.
criteria.remediation: Disable local accounts once Entra integration is in place.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: AKS uses managed Entra integration with Azure RBAC
criteria.text: The cluster uses the managed directory integration and Azure RBAC for Kubernetes authorisation.

checks.unknownReason: aadProfile not present in the export
aadProfile not present in the export

criteria.remediation: Enable the managed Entra integration and Azure RBAC for Kubernetes authorisation.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Workload resources use a managed identity
criteria.text: Clusters and container apps carry a system-assigned or user-assigned managed identity instead of stored credentials.
criteria.remediation: Assign a managed identity to the resource and remove stored credentials.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Registry public network access is disabled
criteria.text: The container registry refuses public network access and is reached through private endpoints.
criteria.remediation: Disable public network access and add a private endpoint.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Registry admin user is disabled
criteria.text: The registry's shared admin account is disabled so pulls and pushes are attributed to identities.
criteria.remediation: Disable the admin user and use managed identities or tokens with scope maps.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Container Apps environment is internal
criteria.text: The environment's ingress is internal to its virtual network rather than public.
criteria.remediation: Create the environment with an internal virtual-network configuration.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: AKS network policy is enabled
criteria.text: The cluster enforces a Kubernetes network policy engine so pod traffic is segmented.
criteria.remediation: Enable Azure, Calico or Cilium network policy on the cluster.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Vaults and storage accounts close public network access
criteria.text: Key vaults and storage accounts disable public network access and are reached privately.
criteria.remediation: Disable public network access and add private endpoints; allow trusted services where required.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Defender for Containers is enabled on the cluster
criteria.text: The cluster's security profile has Defender security monitoring enabled.

checks.unknownReason: securityProfile.defender not present in the export; plan state is set at subscription level

criteria.remediation: Enable Defender for Containers on the subscription and the cluster's security profile.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.

criteria.title: Role assignments are visible for least-privilege review
criteria.text: Role assignments for the scope are present so least-privilege access can be reviewed.

checks.unknownReason: role assignments live in the authorizationresources table, not resources; export them separately to assess

criteria.remediation: Export authorizationresources and review assignments against least privilege.
criteria.attribution: Paraphrased from Microsoft Zero Trust guidance and Azure product documentation (learn.microsoft.com); not affiliated.
